data.group: Death Company Captain with Jump Pack
data.summary: If a fighting enemy unit’s attacks destroy the Death Company Captain with Jump Pack, you may retaliate in the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase). Roll a D6 and add 2 if the enemy **WARLORD** is in the attacking unit. The attacker takes D3 mortal wounds on 2–3, 3 mortal wounds on 4–5, or D3+3 mortal wounds on 6+.
